title: Projects shared by many companies
tagline: Search shows other companies' projects, any member can delete anything, and admins reach into other companies.
lookFor: When many companies share one app, EVERY query must filter by company.
`role === 'admin' || 'owner'` is always true, because non-empty text counts as true.
`findById` ignores the company. Load with `{ _id, tenantId }`.

hints: Compare the filter in `list` with the one in `search`.
bugs.cause: `search` doesn't filter by company, so it returns everyone's projects.

bugs.symptom: A plain member can delete any project
bugs.cause: `|| 'owner'` is always true, so the permission check always passes.

bugs.symptom: An admin from company B can delete company A's project
hints: How is the project loaded in `remove`?
bugs.cause: `findById` doesn't check the company, so an admin anywhere can delete it.
bugs.fix: `projects.findOne({ _id: id, tenantId })` and return 404 if it's not found.
